name: Sanity
short: A random sanity percentage with funny quips.
description: Use [p]sanity to roll a fresh 0–100% sanity score, show a 10-segment meter and receive a random quip for low, medium or high scores. Entertainment only; no stored data, cooldowns, API keys or dependencies.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store user data. Scores are randomly generated for each command and are not retained.
install_msg: Sanity Check installed! Run [p]load sanity and use [p]sanity to roll your score.
